chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 122: Yang Na's Plea & Li Huowang's Cruel Mercy
chapter_meta_description: After witnessing the Ao-Jing Sect's monstrous rituals, Li Huowang's mind shatters back to the hospital where Yang Na begs him to wake up. A devastating choice between love and reality.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 122: Yang Na
og_description: Torn from the blood-soaked caves of a torture cult, Li Huowang is confronted by the love he can't trust. A heartbreaking chapter where the real world hurts more than the hallucination.
twitter_title: Ch. 122 of Dao Gui Yi Xian: The Most Painful Kind of Clarity
twitter_description: Li Huowang pushes Yang Na away to protect her from his broken mind. This is the emotional cost of the Heart-Element.
